say:1:1530125601:1.text: She... she went to the battlefield with the others.
say:1:1530125601:1.source_cn: 她……她跟着其他战士一起，上战场了。
say:1:1530125601:1.male: She... she went to the battlefield with the others.
say:1:1530125601:1.female: She... she went to the battlefield with the others.

say:2:1530125602:1.text: But the war is over. So many have come home... but she hasn't.
say:2:1530125602:1.source_cn: 可是战争结束了，好多人都回来了……她还没回来。
say:2:1530125602:1.male: But the war is over. So many have come home... but she hasn't.
say:2:1530125602:1.female: But the war is over. So many have come home... but she hasn't.
